THE WITNESS

Every person changes the shape of the evidence.
components.css: .ds-evidence{width:280px;padding:24px;background:#0b0a09;color:#f3eee2;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 18px) 0,100% 18px,100% 100%,0 100%);box-shadow:8px 9px 0 rgba(211,34,24,.64),18px 26px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.54)}.ds-evidence small{color:#f05a28;font:700 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.16em}.ds-evidence h3{margin:28px 0 12px;font:400 42px/.88 Impact,'Anton',sans-serif}.ds-evidence p{margin:0;color:#c9c1b2;font:16px/1.55 Georgia,serif}

components.name: Dossier Input
components.description: An inset evidence field with an explicit focus signal.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:#c9c1b2;font:700 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.16em}.ds-field input{width:280px;background:#030303;border:1px solid rgba(243,238,226,.5);border-radius:2px;color:#f3eee2;padding:14px 16px;font:16px/1.4 Georgia,serif;box-shadow:inset 4px 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.ds-field input:focus{outline:2px solid #f05a28;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: A congressional evidence room invaded by an underground political tabloid. Drama is structural: type announces the charge, real images carry proof, and motion turns scrolling into investigation.
keyCharacteristics: Colossal compressed display type with hard offset shadows
Real photography in physical evidence frames
Sticky vertical stages interrupted by horizontal swipe passages
Perspective depth made from stacked paper, not 3D characters

rules.name: The Broad Field Rule
rules.body: Red, orange, and paper may own an entire scene; they are not reduced to decorative dots.

rules.name: The Impact Means Impact Rule
rules.body: The display face appears at architectural scale.

rules.name: The Layer Count Rule
rules.body: A 3D composition needs foreground, subject, and environmental layer.

dos: Do let one memorable typographic or photographic event dominate each viewport.
Do make real portraits large enough to read as people, not thumbnails.
Do use motion to explain sequence, pressure, and relationship.
donts: Don't return to generic SaaS cards, glass panels, pill buttons, or centered-safe hero stacks.
Don't hide essential content behind animation or pointer-only interaction.
